description: Unofficial Faust fan-art companion in her LCB default appearance from Limbus Company. Original routines include inspecting a paper bus diagram, ordering sticky notes, thoughtful abstract note-taking and carefully recovering a misplaced note. Her gray high-neck layer and long dark coat are preserved; shoes and small outfit details are conservatively simplified. Paper props replace real maintenance work, and no weapon is depicted.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
